categories.main_business_segments: Zhongjing Food Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the food manufacturing industry, focusing on two main segments: seasoning foods and seasoning ingredients. The seasoning foods segment includes products like Zhongjing mushroom sauce, Shanghai scallion oil, and quick-cook seasoning sauces. The seasoning ingredients segment specializes in spice extracts such as pepper, chili, ginger, and other spice oils, serving food processing enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including supercritical CO2 extraction and molecular distillation for spice extraction, enabling high-efficiency, residue-free, and natural flavor retention. It has developed a digital flavor evaluation system and quantitative blending technology to standardize flavor substances, moving from traditional sensory-based methods to data-driven production. Production follows a 'sales-driven' model with continuous centralized extraction and flexible blending to meet customer demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhongjing serves both retail consumers and industrial clients. Retail customers are reached through supermarkets, convenience stores, fresh markets, and e-commerce platforms, while industrial clients include food manufacturers and catering enterprises requiring bulk seasoning ingredients. The company also targets restaurant chains and pre-prepared meal producers with specialized large-pack products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales concentrated in Central China, East China, North China, South China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It also has minor overseas sales. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Henan Province, leveraging local specialty resources.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhongjing operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It procures raw materials such as mushrooms and spices, processes them into seasoning products and ingredients, and sells finished goods directly to consumers and food manufacturers. The company also manages its own supply chain with strategic procurement and inventory management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in flavor extraction and product development, focusing on health-oriented seasoning products with reduced additives. R&D priorities include improving extraction technologies for spices, developing new seasoning formulations, and expanding into health food products like ready-to-eat supplements. It also invests in digital transformation for production and marketing, and brand building rooted in cultural heritage.
categories.revenue_model: Zhongjing generates revenue primarily through product sales of seasoning foods and seasoning ingredients. Sales channels include direct-to-consumer e-commerce platforms, traditional retail distribution via dealers, and direct sales to industrial clients. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, but these are minor compared to product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhongjing is a leading brand in the Chinese seasoning industry, recognized as a category pioneer and market leader in mushroom sauce, Shanghai scallion oil, and supercritical CO2 extracted spice ingredients. It ranks among the top in market share nationally for these categories. Competitors include other seasoning manufacturers, but Zhongjing differentiates itself through technological innovation, product quality, and brand heritage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Zhongjing reported operating revenue of approximately 1.1 billion RMB, representing a 10.4% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about 175 million RMB, up 1.8%. The company has maintained positive growth for over a decade, with steady expansion in both revenue and profitability. It employs over 1,100 staff and continues to invest in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhongjing emphasizes 'good ingredients, good taste' with a focus on health, safety, and authentic flavor. Its products are distinguished by the use of premium local raw materials like West Xia mushrooms, advanced extraction technologies ensuring natural and stable flavors, and strict pharmaceutical-grade quality control. The brand leverages cultural heritage and innovation to build consumer trust and loyalty, offering differentiated seasoning solutions for both household and industrial use.
